name: kozmoz-observer
description: Playwright Observer bot for visa portal automation

scripts.run:profile-1: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm run chrome:debug -- -Profile profile-1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm run observer -- --profile profile-1 --pause }"
scripts.run:chrome-only: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm run chrome:debug -- -Profile profile-1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm run observer -- --profile profile-1 --phase chrome-profile --pause }"
